implemented_routes: POST /api/v1/applications (multipart ZIP upload and asynchronous build)
backend_api_mapping.connector_route_status: no matching backend routes currently exist

backend_api_mapping.build_trust_boundary: Dockerfile build commands execute with access to the host Docker daemon; this local MVP is for trusted source only and is not an untrusted-code builder.

zip_upload_flow.persistence: SQLite database at backend/data/cyber_twin.sqlite3; CYBERTWIN_DATA_DIR overrides the data root.

docker_network_topology.target_container: Runs only on the internal target network and receives no host port binding. Runtime limits are 256 MiB memory, 0.5 CPU, 128 PIDs, cap_drop=ALL, no-new-privileges, read-only root, and 32 MiB /tmp tmpfs. The Dockerfile must set a non-root USER; the manager does not force one.
docker_network_topology.proxy_container: Nginx joins both bridges; runs as UID/GID 101 with 64 MiB memory, 0.25 CPU, 64 PIDs, cap_drop=ALL, no-new-privileges, read-only root, and tmpfs writable paths. It publishes container port 8080 on a dynamically chosen 127.0.0.1 host port and reverse-proxies HTTP/WebSocket traffic to the target's configured port.
docker_network_topology.reason_for_proxy: Docker may retain HostConfig.PortBindings without activating a published port for a container attached only to an internal bridge.

docker_file_map.target_dockerfile: Supplied by each uploaded ZIP; required at root or inside one top-level directory.

host_software: Docker Desktop with Linux container engine running; Windows Docker Desktop must be in Linux container mode
project_prerequisites.first_build_network_access: May be needed to pull target base images, nginx:alpine, and application dependencies.

current_digital_twin_implementation.demo_observation: The supplied API MVP responds at /health. Its root / route is undefined and returns a FastAPI Not Found response; this is expected for an API-only archive.
current_digital_twin_implementation.compose: Legacy template for target app, Postgres, connector, and an internal bridge; not used by the new ZIP upload flow.
current_digital_twin_implementation.dockerfile: Generic Python/uvicorn template expects requirements.txt and main:app; runs as root and lacks container restrictions.
current_digital_twin_implementation.proxy: Trusted Nginx sidecar joins the target's internal network and a separate bridge; only the proxy publishes a host port, bound to loopback.
current_digital_twin_implementation.connector: Registers and sends heartbeat only; no source, build, command, lifecycle, or status API integration.
current_digital_twin_implementation.snapshot_manager: Can inspect/commit/replace a named container, but is not wired to an API and replacement does not preserve original runtime configuration.
